rules.magicTen: 10: Burn the discard pile (same player goes again)
rules.fourBurn: Four cards of the same rank in a row burn the pile

magicEffect.two: Reset: next player may play anything
magicEffect.seven: Forced down: next play must be 7 or lower
magicEffect.eight: Skip: skip the next player's turn
magicEffect.ten: Burn: clear the discard pile and play again

sourceBanner.facedown: 🎴 Play a face-down card (you can't see it)

tutorial.intro: Shithead is a shedding game where you clear three layers: hand, face-up, then face-down (blind).
tutorial.playerHand: This is your hand. You may play multiple cards of the same value at once.
tutorial.discardPile: Match or beat the top card of the discard pile, or pick up the pile.
tutorial.magicCards: 2 / 7 / 8 / 10 are magic cards that change the flow of play.

hint.blindPlay: Face-down phase — pick one and play blind.
hint.pickup: No playable cards. Pick up the discard pile.
hint.leadLowest: Discard is empty — lead with your lowest card.
hint.burnTen: Burn the pile with 10 to seize the initiative.
hint.resetTwo: Reset with 2 to escape pressure from a high top card.
hint.playLowest: Play the lowest card that beats or matches the top.
